other_list: D1: M_{Z'} mass is a factor sqrt(2) too small (file uses /6 in the mass formula instead of the paper's /3).
D2: g_X is treated as a free external input (0.5) instead of being derived from s_W and beta as the paper requires.
D3: No third-generation exotic current: the t-T-V' and b-T-Y' vertices are missing, so T is stable in the file.
D4: No heavy lepton currents: the ell-E_ell-Y' and nu_ell-E_ell-V' vertices are missing, leaving E_ell fully inert.
D5: The CKM factors V_ud and V_cs are dropped from the D-d-V' and S-s-V' currents.
D6: No Z' couplings to any SM or exotic fermion are present, so the Z' is stable and cannot be produced.
D7: The Y' and V' kinetic terms use an abelian curl instead of the non-abelian SU(3)_L field strength, so all triple and quartic gauge self-coupling vertices are missing.
D8: The entire scalar interaction sector is absent: no Higgs potential, no CP-even/CP-odd mixing matrices U and O, no mixing angles, and none of the VSS, VVS, VVSS, or scalar-fermion coupling tables.
D13: At the chosen benchmark (v_3 = 2 TeV) the resulting M_Z' sits below the paper's own dilepton exclusion limit of about 3.6-4 TeV.
note: The reviewer's comparison correctly isolates two real coefficient defects (the Z' mass factor and the free g_X) from the much larger set of coverage gaps, so it would send a physicist to the right places in the file.
